From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@heliumhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request — procurement clearing lane and demo access

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from procurement: our PO routed to legal yesterday and they're asking for a couple more days to sign off (vendor checklist + SOC 2 attestation). The pilot is mid-demo with our ML engineering team and we have an executive check-in scheduled for next week — losing access now would stall momentum.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short-term demo credit or keep the sandbox active while our PO clears? We can share the in-flight PO PDF (attached) and prioritize the final signature.

Details: current pilot uses Redwood API for chat + embeddings, expected token consumption ~45k/day during the demo week.

Appreciate any temporary runway you can offer — even a small token grant for 72–96 hours would help.

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
Director of Product, Helium Health
alex.jensen@heliumhealth.com

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO. Sorry to hear legal is adding friction.

I’m going to escalate to our finance and sales ops team right away. We have a standard short-term option we can apply for customers in procurement limbo: a time-limited demo credit (tokens) tied to the in-flight PO + a short usage cap. Before I confirm, can you tell me whether the exec check-in is on Tuesday or Wednesday next week? That’ll help me recommend 72 vs. 96 hours.

I’ll loop in Camila and David internally to get rapid approval — I want to avoid the demo timing affecting your momentum.

Best,

Hi Camila / David,

Forwarding Alex Jensen from Helium Health — PO is in flight but legal needs 48–72 more hours. Their exec review is next Wednesday (2026-07-01).

Proposed temporary remedy: grant a time-limited demo credit of 60k tokens (sufficient for 72 hours at their current burn), with these conditions:
- Tied to PO DH-1042 (they provided PO_helium_0624.pdf)
- Expires automatically after 72 hours or on 2026-07-01 23:59 PT, whichever is sooner
- No refunds; usage auditing enabled; credit revocation if policy violations observed

We typically approve this for high-propensity pilots where legal is the only blocker and the customer has committed to signed PO once cleared. This will preserve ramp momentum for next Wednesday’s exec check-in.

Can we approve this as a one-off? If yes, I’ll notify Alex and attach a short set of voucher instructions (voucher_instructions.txt) and update HubSpot (DH-1042).

Thanks,
Kimberly
